decision: Determine which enrolled trials currently scored with an unknown stoppage driver can be resolved using external, trial-specific evidence before any LLM rescore.
deliverables: A frozen 393-trial cohort with reproducible selection criteria
A source-candidate ledger with query provenance and trial-linkage strength
Preserved abstracts or full-text excerpts for eligible evidence
A precision-reviewed pilot before cohort-wide enrichment
Updated dossiers and a staged rescore only for trials with material new evidence

evidence_tiers.A: Exact NCT identifier in a primary results source, registry, regulatory record, sponsor disclosure, or SEC filing
evidence_tiers.B: Exact protocol identifier or an unambiguous intervention, sponsor, indication, design, enrollment, and date match
evidence_tiers.C: Program-level evidence relevant to program outcome but not sufficient by itself to assign the trial's scientific outcome or stoppage driver
evidence_tiers.exclude: Background biology, another trial of the same intervention, search-result snippets without a stable source, or ambiguous name-only matches

outcomes_to_extract: whether the source reports this exact trial
whether any planned efficacy analysis was performed
primary endpoint result or futility finding

include_sources: Crossref, Europe PMC, and OpenAlex metadata
sponsor press releases and investor materials
scope.languages: Any; machine translation may aid screening but the source language is retained

stopping_rule: For each trial, stop after a primary trial-specific results source is found and corroborated, or after exact-ID searches plus intervention/sponsor/indication searches across the defined source families yield no eligible source. Absence is recorded as search-negative, not as proof that no publication exists.
